scope: Source-derived first-release collector projection descriptor; not runtime or scaling qualification evidence

metric_families.name: iroha_kura_resource_persisted_entries_sum

metric_families.name: iroha_kura_resource_storage_bytes_sum
metric_families.help: Checked logical bytes in the complete declared Kura storage scope.

metric_families.name: iroha_kura_resource_represented_entries
metric_families.help: Checked resident-association plus persisted-entry count; not RSS or transaction count.

scope_boundaries.index: represented resident associations plus persisted slots/standalone index records over all 10 current families
scope_boundaries.storage: exact Kura-managed six declared trees and eight fixed root files; no delegated consensus stores or .kura.lock
scope_boundaries.rss: not provided; must be observed by external process owner
scope_boundaries.queue: ResidentQueue is pipeline/FASTPQ associations, not active transaction queue depth

timing: one Kura snapshot per collector call; caller supplies request start/end using transaction collector Clock; full /metrics latency and size remain independently bounded
